source.rule: For a PLID with several PrelifeData rows, at most one blank QTY row receives all remaining materiel after explicit quantities. An explicit system QTY sum may not exceed SystemDeployment.QTYPS. A blank-QTY PLIND is displayed last in the Prelife Log.

hypothesis_before_native.explicit-two: QTY1/1/2 assigns ages 0/60/120/120 to the four systems in source order; first CAL100 PM starts for IDs 0/1/2/3 at h100/h40/h80/h80.
hypothesis_before_native.remaining-blank: QTY1/1/blank allocates both remaining systems to AGE120 and should reproduce ages 0/60/120/120 and the same first PM times. Two distinct h80 PM tasks may coincide.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both arms import/export exact populated authored tables, convert with zero errors and only inherited event-log #108/no-item #126 warnings, calculate without runtime errors, seal sources and raw outputs, and preserve GUI PID13340 and Prelife Log option NO.
The two arms differ only in the third PrelifeData.QTY cell (2 versus blank) and description; both have QTYPS4 and retain referenced OperationProfile rows with IQTY0.

Prelife Log shows one AGE0, one AGE60, and two AGE120 CALHOURS system records in both arms, with the blank-QTY PLIND last. First CAL100 PM starts at h40 for ID1, h80 for distinct IDs2 and3, and h100 for ID0; no mission runs.
Both arms have 208 contiguous half-hour System/Stock report bins and terminal four ready systems. Event, resource and stock ledgers and PM totals reconcile.
A separately written read-only reviewer replays the frozen source and raw evidence without importing author validation code.
limits: Four same-type top-level systems, one blank-QTY row placed last, fixed CALHOURS ages, one seed, first PM only. Row reordering and multiple blank/overallocated negative cases are separate variants.
No instantiated missions, installed/stocked item prelife, other OPID or topology, GUI visual behavior, later PM cycles, or cross-engine parity.
